description: This file contains unit tests for OpenClawKit's CanvasA2UI module, verifying command string stability, JSONL decoding, validation for specific versions, and error handling for unknown data.

classes.name: CanvasA2UITests
classes.description: A test suite struct containing multiple test cases for the CanvasA2UI functionality.

methods.name: commandStringsAreStable
methods.description: Verifies that specific command string constants have expected raw values.

methods.name: jsonlDecodesAndValidatesV0_8
methods.description: Tests decoding and validation of a sample JSONL string conforming to version 0.8.

methods.name: jsonlRejectsV0_9CreateSurface
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to decode a createSurface message from version 0.9 results in an error.

methods.name: jsonlRejectsUnknownShape
methods.description: Tests that decoding a JSONL message with an unknown shape raises an error.
